description: List a Jira issue's comments (id/author/body/created), capped at 'max' (default 50, cap 100). Read action.
embedding_description: Read the comment thread on a Jira issue — returns each comment's id, author display name, plain-text body, and created timestamp, up to a cap. Use this to review the discussion or hand-off notes on a ticket. Distinct from add_comment (post a new comment), get_issue (the issue's own summary/description), and jql_search (find issues).

result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the discussion. Comment bodies are free-text corporate content (sensitivity 0.6) — surface for the caller but do not treat as public.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: jira.not_found: the issue key does not exist. jira.permission_denied: the account cannot view this issue's comments. jira.invalid_params: the key was missing.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: jira.not_found: verify the issue key. jira.permission_denied: grant the service account browse permission. jira.invalid_params: supply the issue key.
